governance.attested_by: ercot80 unit-only-outages keeper, session 2026-07-17 (the CAMPD outage-detection consolidation). This is the 2026-07-17-ercot76-ne-import keeper recipe (zero ScenarioConfig deltas) re-solved on the UNIT-ONLY CAMPD outage layer: the facility-summed outage layer was deleted entirely (PR #2415) so the per-unit event-based detector is the sole CAMPD outage layer for every ISO, and the ERCOT unit extract was re-derived (2,702 -> 4,910 rows). This run supersedes 2026-07-17-ercot79-corrected-outages as the ERCOT keeper on the most-accurate availability envelope (CLAUDE.md rule 11: prefer accurate/measured data over an estimate even when the fit is no better). ERCOT remains NOT-YET — the keeper recipe does not calibrate on the corrected fleet (C3a/C3b/C3c fail); the open successor lane is a full ERCOT offer-curve + ORDC/co-opt re-calibration.
governance.note: The CAMPD outage-detection consolidation (PR #2415) deleted the facility-summed outage layer (scripts/derive_campd_outages.py + campd-outages.csv/-PJM.csv) that ERCOT-79 identified as manufacturing phantom summer outages for daily-cycling combined-cycle plants (the facility detector summed a plant's units, hiding single-unit outages, and folded daily cyclers into one hard availability=0 window). The per-unit detector — event-based for the load-following classes, never afflicted by that bug — is now the SOLE CAMPD outage layer (fleet.py: unit_outage_derate_factors). The ERCOT unit extract was re-derived on the consolidated detector (2,702 -> 4,910 rows: the corrected revealed-availability filter + 5-day full-stop override keep the shoulder-season dead-stops the old overlap filter dropped, while genuine daily cyclers produce no false window). Source-faithful (measured CAMPD cf + EIA-930 net load only, no residual). RESULT vs the ercot79 facility-detector fix: essentially the same collapsed scarcity state — 2023 C3c tail 53h -> 57h vs RT 181 (0.31x; the unit-only extract keeps a few more genuine shoulder dead-stops so the tail nudges UP, not down, but stays a deep miss), 2024 16h -> 22h vs 53, 2025 0h vs 31; C3a 2023 -36.0% -> -33.4% (model $41.05 -> $42.69 vs RT $64.12, still FAIL; 2024/2025 pass); C3b 2023 NRMSE 0.685 -> 0.675 but 2024 0.193 (PASS) -> 0.263 (FAIL). DETERMINATION unchanged: NOT-YET. Removing the facility-summing phantom MORE completely does not re-form the real scarcity — the ERCOT offer/scarcity calibration (offer curves, ORDC/co-opt) was tuned against the phantom-tightened fleet and rests on that room exhaustion; one availability mechanism owned BOTH the Jun/Sep shoulder over-shoot (fixed at ercot79, $1,068 -> $242) and the caught August tail (un-caught). Per CLAUDE.md rule 11 the accurate unit-only input is kept and the compensating miscalibration is exposed, not buried. Open lane (successor): a full ERCOT offer-curve + ORDC/co-opt re-calibration against the corrected availability envelope so the real scarcity re-forms on real fleet tightness. See results/calibration/FINDING-ercot79-phantom-outage-2026-07.md.

exceptions.magnitude: 57h vs RT actual 181h (0.31x, FAIL — rubric v2.7 RT basis); 2024 22h vs 53 (0.42x FAIL); 2025 0h vs 31 (0.00x FAIL)
exceptions.reason: SCARCITY-TAIL COLLAPSE ON THE UNIT-ONLY AVAILABILITY ENVELOPE (ERCOT-80). Same structural finding as ERCOT-79: the deposed ercot76 keeper caught the real scarcity tail (2023 179h vs 181) on PHANTOM fleet tightness manufactured by the CAMPD facility-outage detector (daily-cycling CC folded into summer-long false outages). The outage-detection consolidation (PR #2415) deletes the facility layer entirely and makes the per-unit event-based detector the sole outage layer (measured CEMS + EIA-930, no residual), removing the phantom more completely; the tail stays collapsed (57h vs 181; on the real August/summer scarcity hours the model settlement price falls far short). One availability mechanism owned BOTH the Jun/Sep shoulder over-shoot (fixed at ercot79) and the caught tail (un-caught). This is out-of-admissible-representation for the CURRENT offer/scarcity calibration, which was fitted against the phantom-tightened fleet; it is NOT a single-lane mechanism gap. Successor lane: re-calibrate the ERCOT offer curves + ORDC/co-opt against the corrected availability envelope so the real scarcity re-forms on real fleet tightness. Until then ERCOT is NOT-YET.
